intro.text: A Knight Radiant from long ago whom Dalinar meets in one of his visions.
A Stoneward Knight Radiant from long ago whom Dalinar meets in one of his visions.

items.text: With a Radiant companion, she came to the aid of a family attacked by the Midnight Essence, healing the father, whose place Dalinar had taken, and his wife with a fabrial before joining the fight. Surprised at Dalinar's skill with a fireplace poker, she fought beside him until the creatures were destroyed.
Left to guard the family, she told a puzzled Dalinar they were in Natanatan in the Eighth Epoch, and that the creatures were not Voidbringers but the Midnight Essence, one of the Ten Deaths.

She explained that the Radiants trained for war to stand ready for the Desolations, invited Dalinar to train with them, and mentioned that Harkaylain had foretold a Desolation soon, before hurrying off toward screams.

appearance.text: Light tan skin and glowing light tan eyes, with her hair in a bun. She wears delicate Shardplate glowing with amber light, and can summon and dismiss its helm.

personality.text: Calm and focused in danger; she sees her duty as protecting the world by training in war.
